summary: A survival horror game with scary monsters, offline play and online multiplayer
description:
You came for horror games. You found the one.

Eyes - The Horror Game is a scary game where you search dark rooms, collect bags of money, and find your way out while a monster hunts you. Listen for danger, learn the routes, and keep moving when the chase begins.

You can play this horror game alone, even offline, or if you enjoy scary titles with friends, team up in online co-op. Prefer a little competition? Challenge other players in Versus mode.

Looking for horror games with lore? Explore a haunted mansion, an abandoned hospital, and a deserted school. Uncover the secrets connecting them and piece together the story of a cursed family, a thief, and fears made real.

What else awaits you?
• Face Krasue, Charlie, Good Boy, and Ursula, each with a different way of hunting you.
• Design your own monster using custom images and sounds.
• Discover notes, objects, and hidden details that reveal more of the story.
• Try different game modes and compete on global leaderboards.
• Unlock achievements and take on new challenges.

Flickering lights and unsettling sounds make it hard to feel safe. Use your map to plan a route, watch for signs the monster is nearby, and collect Eye runes to see through its eyes and track its position.

Why players love Eyes:
- A chilling single-player experience and real-time multiplayer modes.
- A classic survival horror game built for mobile.

The money is still inside. So is the thing hunting you. Can you make it out? Let the horror game begin.
